task: Add memory and resource leak prevention gate.

resource_risks.description: The new resource guard should not become a long-running process or retain unbounded state while checking resource risk inputs.
resource_risks.mitigation: The implementation loads one JSON input, converts bounded arrays into dataclasses, produces a report, and exits. It does not create a persistent worker, browser, cache, stream, network connection, or file handle.

resource_risks.description: Future agents could add long-running servers, browser automation, workers, caches, or subprocesses without cleanup and measurement evidence.
resource_risks.mitigation: Persistent instructions, workflow 69, prompt 100, work mode registry, and work evaluator now require resource_check_targets when resource_risk_occurred=true.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: CLI opens and parses the supplied JSON file for one command invocation.
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: The command exits after printing JSON; resource_guard.py creates no persistent process, browser context, worker, cache, stream, or network connection.

measurement_checks.threshold: 131 tests complete without hanging or starting persistent runtime resources.

notes: This task added the guard and conditional evaluator gate; it did not add a long-running runtime component.
